verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents using any LLM provider by configuring API keys, more than 75 providers through Models.dev including local models, and Copilot and ChatGPT account logins. Community users confirm running llama.cpp, Claude, Gemini and local Qwen models, and choosing which model powers each agent. One user reports the model/provider switch across sessions is annoying, which is a UX complaint rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the in-session model-switching workflow, and support for providers that require non-streaming HTTP (one user reports these are unavailable).

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: With OpenCode you can use any LLM provider by configuring their API keys.
75+ LLM providers through Models.dev, including local models
as a bonus I get to choose which model is in which agent.
i've been using this as my primary harness for llama.cpp models, Claude, and Gemini for a few months now.
